decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm’s metal fabrication and utility-focused offer, it is a low-cost option to keep while market acceptance is still uncertain.
Public waste bins are relatively distant from the firm’s established niche, so with several other new options available this one is the likeliest to be cut if early demand is unclear.
Ground sleeves fit the firm’s fabrication capabilities and customer base well, so the option value of staying in the market likely exceeds the modest cost of keeping it listed.

Cast iron ground sleeves are adjacent to the core offer but somewhat less natural than the firm’s steel-based strengths, so they are worth keeping for now but with a higher chance of later rationalization.
Steel ground sleeves are strongly aligned with the firm’s materials expertise and existing production setup, making them an attractive option to retain while uncertainty resolves.
